title: Maharashtra government introduces rule requiring liquor shops in residential areas to obtain NOC from societies
summary: The Maharashtra government has introduced a new rule requiring liquor shops in residential areas to obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the society where they are located. This move aims to curb the proliferation of liquor shops in residential areas and ensure that only those with the consent of the society can operate. The government has granted NOC veto power to housing complexes, allowing them to reject applications for liquor shops within their premises.
summary_points: The Maharashtra government has introduced a new rule requiring liquor shops in residential areas to obtain an NOC from societies.
